families.description: Fuliza M-PESA overdraft drawdown. Arrives as a second SMS carrying the SAME code as the payment it funded (dedupe key includes family_id). Direction in: the overdraft tops up M-PESA. fee = the interest / access fee, which is added to the Fuliza outstanding, not deducted from M-PESA (the balance chain treats it so). No date in the body: occurred_at = received_at. Source: corpus/mpesa/unverified-public-samples.jsonl (public parser repos, redacted); verified: false until a real export passes.
families.pattern: ^(?<external_ref>[A-Z0-9]{8,12})\s*Confirmed\.\s*Fuliza M-PESA amount is Ksh\s?(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)\.\s*(?:Interest|Access Fee) charged Ksh\s?(?<fee>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)\.\s*Total Fuliza M-PESA outstanding amount is Ksh\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})? due on \d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{2,4}

examples.body: FYJ8HLFQ9T Confirmed. Fuliza M-PESA amount is Ksh 100.00. Interest charged Ksh 1.00. Total Fuliza M-PESA outstanding amount is Ksh 422.93 due on 06/01/24. To check daily charges, Dial *234*0#OK Select Query Charges

families.description: Reversal debited from the user (the user had received the money). note = the code of the reversed transaction. Source: corpus/mpesa/unverified-public-samples.jsonl (public parser repos, redacted); verified: false until a real export passes.
families.pattern: ^(?<external_ref>[A-Z0-9]{8,12})\s*confirmed\.\s*Reversal of transaction (?<note>[A-Z0-9]{8,12}) has been successfully reversed\s+on\s+(?<occurred_at>\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{2,4}\s+(?:at\s+)?\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s*[AP]M)\s+and Ksh(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?) is debited from your M-PESA account\.\s*New M-PESA account balance is Ksh(?<balance_after>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)

examples.body: UJLD7YJGIT confirmed. Reversal of transaction DQER5MQGHH has been successfully reversed on 8/3/26 at 10:48 PM and Ksh50.00 is debited from your M-PESA account. New M-PESA account balance is Ksh3,920.00.

families.description: Jumbe split notification (Safaricom, from July 2026): a SECOND SMS for a till payment, without a balance, carrying the till number. Ignored because the Buy Goods confirmation already recorded the payment; a later engine version may merge the till number into it. Sample is Safaricom's published example as quoted by Techweez (https://techweez.com/2026/10/06/safaricom-jumbe-mpesa-split-notifications/).
families.pattern: ^(?<external_ref>[A-Z0-9]{8,12})\s*Confirmed\.\s*You sent: Ksh(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)\.\s*Received by: (?<counterparty_name>.+?)\.\s*TILL: (?<till>[\dX]+)\.\s*Your JumbeID: .+?\.\s*Date: (?<occurred_at>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} at \d{2}:\d{2})

examples.body: PLTV813ZSO Confirmed. You sent: Ksh2,000.00. Received by: REDACTED MERCHANT Till. TILL: XXXX900. Your JumbeID: REDACTED ID. Date: 2026-06-10 at 14:56:38.

families.description: Balance enquiry; no money moves. Source: corpus/mpesa/unverified-public-samples.jsonl (public parser repos, redacted); verified: false until a real export passes.
families.pattern: ^(?<external_ref>[A-Z0-9]{8,12})\s*Confirmed\.\s*Your account balance was:\s*M-PESA Account\s*:\s*Ksh(?<balance_after>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)(?:.*? on (?<occurred_at>\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{2,4}\s+(?:at\s+)?\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s*[AP]M))?

examples.body: OVJAS3RA9A Confirmed. Your account balance was: M-PESA Account : Ksh3.51 Business Account : Ksh0.00 on 13/6/26 at 8:07 AM. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00. Get a Lipa Na M-PESA Till online: https://m-pesaforbusiness.co.ke/
